title: Vectors & Geometry
description: Vector arithmetic, dot and cross product, lines and planes in space.
html:
➡️ Vectors & Geometry

1. Calculating with vectors

$$\overrightarrow{AB} = B - A, \qquad |v| = \sqrt{v_1^2 + v_2^2 + v_3^2}, \qquad e_v = \tfrac{v}{|v|}$$

Addition component by component, $\lambda v$ stretches the arrow.

2. Dot product

$$a \cdot b = a_1 b_1 + a_2 b_2 + a_3 b_3 = |a||b|\cos\varphi, \qquad \cos\varphi = \tfrac{a \cdot b}{|a||b|}$$

  • $a \cdot b = 0 \iff a \perp b$
  • Projection of $b$ onto $a$: $\frac{a \cdot b}{|a|^2}\,a$

3. Cross product

$$a \times b = (a_2 b_3 - a_3 b_2,\ a_3 b_1 - a_1 b_3,\ a_1 b_2 - a_2 b_1), \qquad |a \times b| = |a||b|\sin\varphi$$

Perpendicular to $a$ and $b$, anticommutative ($b \times a = -a \times b$), length = parallelogram area. Triangle area: $\frac{1}{2}|a \times b|$.

4. Lines and planes

$$g: x = p + tu, \qquad E: n \cdot (x - p) = 0 \iff n_1 x_1 + n_2 x_2 + n_3 x_3 = d$$

Position of two lines

Directions parallel? → parallel/identical. Otherwise equate: solvable → intersecting, unsolvable → skew.

Distance point–plane

$$d(P, E) = \frac{|n \cdot P - d|}{|n|}$$
